statement: The pinned SDL Xbox One HIDAPI implementation recognizes Elite paddles and budgets four extra joystick buttons. Its original Elite 29-byte state-packet path uses original-specific paddle positions and compares mapped and raw button states; it suppresses separate paddle button delivery when remapping is detected. Elite Series 2 has separate firmware-dependent state formats and a different paddle layout.
